purpose: Record, before construction, the extra premises that 017.21a adds once the 017.20 evidence fence is dropped.
retained_from_017_20: the byte-frozen abstract Fano Point x Line source schema and its SHA-256
zero learned parameters and no training, optimizer, or Interact code
no per-instance target probability, preparation, effect, or answer field
one input-independent test for all admitted inputs
adversarial rival search before any canonicality claim
explicit declared / derived / still-constitutive residue accounting
a matched structure-removal control that must fail closed
no predictive, physical-realization, or training-economy claim

dropped_fence.what_was_dropped: the 017.20 restriction to already-certified bridges under a closed evidence list
dropped_fence.what_that_permits: deriving a new natural target construction from the reduced effect algebra itself
what_it_does_not_permit: inventing source semantics after inspecting the target
reverse-engineering the source schema to speak target geometry
claiming physical Test Realization or Outcome constitution

added_premises.name: reduced ordered Jordan effect algebra
added_premises.statement: The target observable space is the certified reduced Fixed span with its inherited unital ordered Jordan structure, E = span{g0,g1,g3,g4} with Phi(E) = Sym_2(R) + R and unit (I_2, 1).

added_premises.name: full formal effect interval
added_premises.statement: The admissible formal effects are the whole order interval [0, 1_E], and a formal test is any finite family of effects summing exactly to 1_E.
added_premises.status: declared by 017.21a; not established as physical Test Realization
added_premises.authority: Theory 27 formal Test_formal(E) type; Theory 41 keeps formal effecthood distinct from physical realization

added_premises.name: operational state target
added_premises.statement: The compiler codomain is the operational state space S(E) of positive unital functionals on E, not a raw ray of P(R^16). Two ambient rays inducing the same functional on E are the same output.
added_premises.authority: Theory 27 factors evaluation through P(V) -> S(E), then S(E) x Eff(E) -> [0,1]

added_premises.name: invariant central-character extension
added_premises.statement: A compiled preparation must be the unique target-automorphism-invariant state extending the selected character of the center of E.
added_premises.status: declared by 017.21a; load-bearing and independently required
added_premises.necessity: without P4 the binding-conditioned compiler is a continuum, not unique; the omega_t counterexample witnesses this

deliberately_unresolved.name: central label orientation
deliberately_unresolved.statement: Nothing in the source schema or the target algebra selects which source relation class binds to which minimal central idempotent.
deliberately_unresolved.must_be: enumerated as inequivalent alternatives, never silently defaulted

preregistered_falsifiers: if the two minimal central idempotents are not unique or not automorphism-fixed, the canonical test claim fails
if some target automorphism swaps the two central idempotents, the residue is gauge and the classification must drop toward C2
if a positive unital non-invariant state also reproduces the exact central distributions, then P4 is necessary and unconditional C3 must be rejected
if any ambient ray fiber over a compiled state has more than one element, no canonical raw-ray compiler may be claimed
if the relation-erased control still yields a compiled state, the source relation was not load-bearing
declared_but_not_claimed: that GL(3,2) acts nontrivially on E or S(E)
that the ambient 16-dimensional carrier contains no Fano-equivariant structure
any sample-complexity, compute, parameter, or accuracy advantage
